authors: Oriá AP, Gomes Junior DC, Oliveira AVD, Curvelo VP, Estrela-Lima A, Pinna MH, Meneses IDS, Filho EFM, Ofri R
title: Selected ophthalmic diagnostic tests, bony orbit anatomy, and ocular histology in sambar deer (Rusa unicolor)
why: The abstract gives the orbit as fully enclosed by bone and the histology as typical of mammals; the full text may describe the pupil, tapetum and retina of the genus Rusa (g for Rusa marianna).
